# HealthGraph

> HealthGraph connects pulse, sleep, meds, meals, cycle, documents and 3D body into one private on-device health graph. Free to start, free to keep. Wellness companion, not a medical device. No diagnosis, no prescriptions.
> DE: Gesundheit verbunden. Puls per Kamera, Schlaf, Medikamente, Ernährung, Zyklus, Dokumente in einem Graph. DSGVO-konform. 0 € Start.

## Core pages

- [Home](https://healthgraph.shop/#home): Health, connected. One graph holds it all.
- [Features](https://healthgraph.shop/#features): Camera pulse, documents, meds, sleep. / Kamera-Puls, Dokumente, Medis, Schlaf.
- [Capabilities](https://healthgraph.shop/#capabilities): 16 capabilities across Measure, Understand, Manage, Act.
- [App](https://healthgraph.shop/#app): A day with it, 07:12 to 22:47.
- [Why](https://healthgraph.shop/#why): 10 apps, 10 subscriptions, none connected. One graph.
- [Pricing](https://healthgraph.shop/#pricing): Free EUR 0, General EUR 11/mo, All-in EUR 18/mo.
- [FAQ](https://healthgraph.shop/#faq): Medical device, data home, free tier, wearables, family watch.
- [Answers hub](https://healthgraph.shop/#queries): 100 EN + 60 DE questions, each answered from the app.

## Data rights

- On-device first, encrypted cache wiped on logout, DSGVO/GDPR aware, export or delete in one tap, never sold.
